integrity: The infinite statement is established by a direct structural proof. Exhaustive computation is used only to stress-test the characterization and coefficient formula on small instances. The secure-domination definition, boundary cases, quantifiers, and parameter reconstruction were checked explicitly.
scientific_limitations: The formula is proved only for uniform generalized windmills \(K_1\vee rK_m\) with \(r,m\ge2\). An earlier 2003 secure-domination paper is bibliographically known but lacked exact-day evidence in the inspected public sources; no day was imputed. A plausible block-graph algorithm source was available only at abstract level, leaving a residual literature-coverage risk.
title: Secure-domination polynomial of generalized windmill graphs
